description:
Give the dependency auto-transition a pure domain owner, so the command cascade only applies a decision the domain makes.

## Background

The readiness predicates are tested in `crates/jit/src/domain/types.rs:2546-2703`, and `domain/types.rs` already decides the readiness change for one stored issue. The cascade to dependents is command-layer orchestration (`crates/jit/src/commands/issue.rs:816-859`, `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs:2791`). It is re-proven by four CLI tests in `crates/jit/tests/cli_repo_workflow/workflow_tests.rs` (`:529`, `:577`, `:646`, `:698`) and by harness tests (`commands/bulk_update.rs:2001`, `tests/fast_issue/lifecycle_timestamps_tests.rs:89`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One pure domain function takes the issue graph after a transition and returns the issues that become ready. Every command cascade, including the delete cascade, applies that result and decides nothing itself.
- [hard] REQ-02: Unit tests and a property-based test of that function own the auto-transition rules, including dependents with other unmet dependencies, rejected dependencies and dependents outside backlog, and each rule the four `workflow_tests.rs` cases and the lifecycle harness cascade assertions check.
- [hard] REQ-03: Command behaviour and emitted events are unchanged.
title: Auto-transition readiness is decided by a pure domain function
